verdict.rationale: Agent Studio lets teams define step-by-step workflows and generate journeys from existing operating procedures, and Ghostwriter can build journeys from uploaded SOPs. The Agent SDK supports journeys-as-code with sophisticated logic, and Insights mentions tunable levels of determinism, which together imply controllable branching. missing for 10: explicit documentation of deterministic branching/conditional step logic within journeys, independent hands-on corroboration of SOP-following reliability.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I encode standard operating procedures the agent follows step-by-step for known issue types, with deterministic branching

citations.quote: Define step-by-step workflows for your agent from scratch, or use AI to instantly generate journeys from your existing operating procedures.
Upload SOPs, raw transcripts, or even audio interviews of subject matter experts to create customer journeys from scratch.
write customer journeys as code, track changes, and build sophisticated logic without giving up our development workflows
Experiment with variations of agent behavior, such as hand-off rules or levels of determinism
